info.title: Marplanner HTTP API
info.description: Household planning API served by the Marplanner backend. Everything under `/api/*` requires the `mp_device_key` device cookie minted by `POST /api/auth/provision` (the plugin-management subtree `/api/plugins*` also admits an integration bearer key); `/health` is public. This document is generated from the zod route schemas in `src/server/openapi/` (`npm run generate:openapi`).

deviceKeyCookie.name: mp_device_key
deviceKeyCookie.description: The minted `*` device key (an `mpk-…` value). Set HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Lax at provisioning; never readable by client JS and never echoed in any response body.

integrationKey.description: Existing raw-header integration credential whose live scopes include `*`.

memberIds.description: Full replacement set; each MUST be an active member (FR-006). Atomic replace.

AssignmentUpsert.description: Upsert (create-or-edit) the one logical assignment row for (routineId, memberId) — reactivation reuses the existing row (FR-005). memberId MUST be an active child at write time (INV-01/FR-001).

year.description: present only when known; null = no age, never invented (MEMBERS-AC-07)

BirthDate.description: Month/day always present when set; year optional. Feb 29 allowed with a null year.

data.description: Frozen block data, present for successful blocks.

index.description: 1-based position in the member's full effective block order at generation; omitted blocks leave gaps (e.g. [1, 3]). Not a stable identity.

BlockParams.description: Closed per-instance params (mirrors settings.ts ALLOWED_PARAM_KEYS; unknown keys are rejected 400 by validateParams —  fold closed this schema to match).

streak.description: Consecutive qualifying days ending at the most recent one (FR-013). Present (a number, possibly 0) ONLY when the requested date is today; null for any other date — the suppression (FR-014, INV-09) is enforced server-side, not left to the client to hide.

BoardDayPeriod.description: One of the four fixed periods, always present even when chores is empty (DAY-PERIODS-AC-05).

enqueued.description: false when a job for this briefing was already waiting and was reused.

BriefingReadResultV2.description: Pure read result with derived printed status for generated briefings.

subject.description: First line of the commit message.

builtAt.description: Build time; null for a server running from source.

BuildInfo.description: The commit a server or client bundle was built from; unknown parts are null.

registered.description: always true on 200 — the calling session's key is now print-capable (FR-021, ADR-035)

sound.description: Play the fanfare with a completion celebration. Household-wide; reduced motion does not mute it.

CelebrationSettings.description: Household completion-celebration settings. Default `{ sound: true }`.

choreIds.description: Full ordered list of the routine's active chore ids (atomic replace, FR-005/FR-006).

items.description: Each raw entry is validated independently; invalid entries and entries beyond the first 100 are dropped and counted. ClientLogEntryInput describes an admissible entry.

data.description: Arbitrary structured diagnostic values; bounded and redacted at ingest.

eventTime.description: Client-claimed epoch ms; advisory only (received_at is authoritative).

data.description: Redacted, bounded JSON text exactly as stored, or null.

ConditionKey.description: Closed union from the single shared WMO map (WEATHER-INV-06).

code.description: machine code identifying which controller-degradation state this 502 represents — `controller_unavailable`, `controller_rejected`, or `controller_unreachable` (the three `NetworkDeviceController*Error` classes in src/server/modules/network-devices/index.ts, mapped via src/server/routes/network-devices.ts). Unlike the shared ErrorResponse, both fields are ALWAYS present on this response — every 502-mapped error class carries its own `code`.

colorKey.description: Optional explicit key. If omitted, choose the first unused active-member key in palette order, or active-member count modulo ten after exhaustion. Archived members do not reserve keys. An explicit key that another active member holds is rejected (400) while any key is still unused.

birthDate.description: optional birth date; null or absent = no birth date set.

updatedAt.description: epoch-ms; null when no row exists yet

memberSchedules.description: stored weekday pause schedules; members without one run every day (FR-023).

text.description: stored byte-for-byte verbatim (AC-07). Blank-after-trim / over-500-char rejection (AC-03/FR-005) is enforced on writes.

labelKey.description: i18n translation key (INV-04); never user-editable free text.

start.description: Local start boundary HH:MM (the only stored boundary; end is derived).

current.description: the credential this request authenticated with

configuredBootstrap.description: the bootstrap row MP_BOOTSTRAP_KEY names; startup re-activates it, so revoking it is refused

DeviceCredential.description: An API credential without its key or key hash.

DeviceCredentialLabelRequest.description: Trimmed before storing; 1 to 80 characters after trimming.

revoked.description: false when it was already revoked

DryRunReason.description: The 3 mutually-exclusive reasons a calendar_gated rule would NOT emit (present iff wouldEmit=false), computed from up to 3 getEvents probes A/B/C. Precedence: no_assigned_events (probe A empty) -> matched_but_unassigned (probe C non-empty, gate probe B empty) -> query_miss (probe C empty) — matched_but_unassigned is checked BEFORE query_miss so it is reachable (finding #2).

DryRunResult.description: The verdict: would this calendar_gated rule emit for (memberId, date), and if not, why. wouldEmit=true iff the gate probe (member's assigned events matching the query) is non-empty; reason is present iff wouldEmit=false.

EditDeviceRequest.description: The MAC is NOT editable — no property for it exists (INV-02).

EffectiveSettings.description: Core settings and active plugin-owned settings, with defaults filling unpersisted fields. Weather is omitted while its plugin is inactive.

Error.description: Generic error envelope. Error bodies never contain `mpk-`/`mpg-` values or raw PINs (SC-004).

PrinterSettings.description: Persisted printer configuration only; it does not assert a connected or capable printer.

anyOf.description: Unconfigured: the default every field falls back to.

PrinterTransportSettings.description: Private local transport configuration accepted only while Printing is active; it is not pairing, connectivity, capability, or activity state. Either all four fields are empty (unconfigured) or `deviceId`/`name` are non-empty and both UUIDs are well-formed.

code.description: machine code, present on a subset of errors: `printer_capability_missing` (403, FR-021) and `render_failure` (422, FR-017) are the two this contract maps with one; a plain 400 validation error omits it.

active.description: current printing-plugin-active state (INV-06); the client-side read FR-013's family-facing hiding gates on (issue 691) — PrintExecutor and the admin nav entry for PrintingManagement both hide when false

ProvisionResult.description: Success body carries NO raw key — the minted device key is delivered only via Set-Cookie (FR-007). The raw key never appears here or in any error body (SC-004).

RecipeEditInput.description: Partial edit; at least one property required.

ingredients.description: One entry per line; blanks dropped module-side.

slots.description: Absent/empty means suitable for all slots (picker suggestion only).

liveStatus.description: derived at read time, never persisted (INV-04)

targetingMode.description: editable through PATCH (FR-019); kind is immutable.

text.description: parent-authored, stored as authored (trimmed). Non-blank for a `text` reminder; an optional, possibly empty, description of an `images` reminder.

emojis.description: the emoji sequence of an `images` reminder; null for `text`.

weekdays.description: rule-level weekday set for apply_to_all; null for specific (per-member weekdays live on each assignment). Cross-field discriminant (INV-09).

assignments.description: active assignments embedded in GET reads (the member x weekday matrix source); populated for specific-mode rules, empty array for apply_to_all.

Reminder.description: Stored discriminated rule. Scheduled specific assignments carry non-empty weekdays; calendar-gated assignments carry empty weekdays and a query. Active-member and uniqueness invariants are enforced by the service.

ReminderAssignmentSetInput.description:
The full desired active assignment set for a specific-mode rule. Applied atomically (last-write-wins, no If-Match/409 — deferred #395): members present are upserted, members absent are deactivated. MUST be non-empty (a specific rule may not drop to zero active assignments — INV-02).
 The stored rule kind determines whether weekdays must be non-empty (scheduled) or absent/empty (calendar_gated).

ReminderContentType.description: What the reminder shows: words (`text`) or an ordered emoji sequence (`images`) for family members who cannot read yet.

contentType.description: switching to images requires emojis; switching to text requires a non-blank text (given, or the stored description) and clears emojis.

text.description: must be non-blank when the resulting contentType is text.

emojis.description: full replacement list; accepted only when the resulting contentType is images.

assignments.description: full desired set; accepted only when the resulting targetingMode is specific.

ReminderEditInput.description: Partial edit; kind is immutable. targetingMode may switch between apply_to_all and specific. Switching to specific requires assignments; switching a scheduled rule to apply_to_all requires weekdays; a calendar_gated rule switching to apply_to_all needs nothing extra. Weekdays are valid only when the resulting mode is apply_to_all on a scheduled rule; assignments only when the resulting mode is specific (full-set replace). Query fields only on stored calendar_gated rules. These state-dependent constraints are enforced by the service; a rejected edit persists nothing. Switching to apply_to_all deactivates (never deletes) the rule's active assignments.

ReminderEmission.description: one emitting reminder for a (member,date); ordering/priority deferred to Daily Briefing. `emojis` is present only for an `images` reminder, whose `text` is then its (possibly empty) description.

ReminderEmojis.description: Ordered catalog emojis of an `images` reminder (1–12; repeats allowed). Each must be one the app ships a Noto SVG for; others are rejected 400.

text.description: required and non-blank for a text reminder; an optional description for images.

emojis.description: required iff contentType=images; rejected for text.

weekdays.description: required iff targetingMode=apply_to_all; rejected for specific.

assignments.description: required iff targetingMode=specific; rejected for apply_to_all.

targetDate.description: household-local today (YYYY-MM-DD) whose print records were reset

cancelledJobs.description: pending or claimed-not-yet-fetched jobs cancelled; fetched jobs finish (H2)

dayPeriodId.description: Day period the routine belongs to; PATCH may move it (FR-015).

RoutineEditInput.description: Edit payload — any of name, active and dayPeriodId (FR-015).

alreadyPrinted.description: true when FR-012 dedup suppressed the enqueue

time.description: Strict 24h HH:MM, stored exactly as written (never normalized).

weekDays.description: Non-empty canonical set, no duplicates, canonical order on read.

code.description: machine code from the shared auth boundary (src/server/auth/boundary.ts, fix #682) — always `credential_invalid` on a 401 from this cross-cutting preHandler; optional here since older/other 401 emitters may not set it.

colorKey.description: A curated key; duplicates are allowed. Omission preserves the existing key, as do archive and restore.

birthDate.description: null explicitly clears the birth date (FR-009a). Omitted fields are unchanged.

celebration.description: Replaces the celebration as a whole. Omission keeps the current one.

UpdateMemberRequest.description: Partial profile update. Must include at least one field; role=admin rejected.

VerifyPinResult.description: Advisory only — no session is created; grants no backend authority (FR-016/026).

WeatherBlockPayload.description: The `data` shape of a `BlockInstance` whose `type` is `weather` (, the Weather domain contract). Present only when the household's forecast `daily[]` covers the briefing's household-local `date` (WEATHER-INV-05); frozen once written (WEATHER-INV-09) — regeneration is the only refresh. `BlockInstance.data` stays the generic `[object, array, 'null']` schema above (untyped per-type, matching every other block type's precedent) — this schema documents what a `weather`-typed block's `data` actually contains (the route-only drift gate cannot see this body-shape change, hence the explicit ripple-edit).

label.description: Optional free text; absent ⇒ no place label rendered; never reverse-geocoded (WEATHER-INV-08).

WeatherLocation.description: Both-or-neither non-null (partial pair rejected on write, WEATHER-INV-02); clearing writes both null as one unit.

forecast.description: null = silent absence: blank location, operator-disabled, or failed/timed-out fetch (WEATHER-INV-12). Never expressed as an HTTP error.

WeekMenu.description: Week grid: a map of the 7 local YYYY-MM-DD dates of the week (from `weekStartDay` + tz) to that date's derived menu grouped by slot (breakfast/lunch/snack/dinner -> MenuItem[]; an empty slot is `[]`).

object.description: Registered object name. Core locale and celebration are always available; inactive plugin-owned objects are not projected by GET /api/settings.

settings.description: Complete replacement object. The Settings domain rejects unknown or invalid fields and writes a valid object atomically. For `printerTransport`, either all four fields are empty or `deviceId` and `name` are non-empty and `serviceUuid`/`characteristicUuid` are well-formed 128-bit UUIDs (8-4-4-4-12 hex, any version nibble), stored lower-case.

tags.name: bootstrap
tags.description:
**Marplanner foundation API**

Health, frontend access, device provisioning, PIN verification and household settings. Device cookies authorize the API. Effective settings contain only active contributions; the UI PIN is advisory.

tags.name: settings
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Settings registry API**

Read the effective settings projection (core locale plus the settings objects of active plugins) and atomically replace one registered settings object. The UI PIN does not authorize writes.

tags.name: members
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Members referential root API**

Member creation, editing, archive and restore. Member roles and lifecycle are validated independently from API credential capabilities. Historical records remain readable after archival.

tags.name: day-periods
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Day Periods vocabulary API**

The fixed four household day periods and their editable start times. Ordering and uniqueness are validated; end boundaries derive from the next start.

tags.name: chores
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Household Daily Chores Board API**

Routines, member assignments, dated completion and derived streaks. Active-member validation applies on writes; historical reads tolerate archived members.

tags.name: calendar
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Calendar local feed API**

Local and imported events, recurrence, member assignment, highlight rules and source metadata. Timed events preserve UTC instants and originating timezones; all-day dates use exclusive end boundaries.

**Marplanner Calendar Feed Synchronization API**

External calendar source configuration, synchronization and safe diagnostics. Fetch validation rejects private network destinations; writes reconcile complete source results atomically.

tags.name: meals
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Meals & Recipes API**

Recipe catalogue, meal types and additive dated or recurring meal entries. Deleting a recipe requires an informed cascade; read projections remain derived from current data.

tags.name: reminders
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Scheduled Reminders API**

Scheduled reminder CRUD, assignment replacement, and live emissions. Supports all-member and explicit-member modes. Assignment replacement is atomic; the advisory UI PIN does not authorize backend requests.

**Marplanner — Calendar-gated Reminders API delta**

Calendar-gated reminders extend scheduled reminder CRUD and assignments with query rules and dry-run explanations. Request shapes are discriminated by reminder kind.

tags.name: daily-messages
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Daily Messages API**

Per-member daily messages with strict dates and text validation. Writes require an active member; reads preserve archived-member history and reject unknown members. The device-key cookie authorizes backend access.

tags.name: daily-briefing
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Daily Briefing API**

Briefing block configuration, generation, preview and print integration. The server composes and renders content; printing uses the current registered provider at execution time.

**Marplanner — Daily Briefing API**

Member briefing generation, opt-in settings, snapshots and status. Calendar, chores, reminders, meals and messages are read through their owning domain interfaces.

tags.name: time-announcements
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Time Announcements API**

Rule-CRUD surface for. The server owns rule DATA ONLY — firing is entirely client-side (ADR-051 as reconciled by ADR-065): no server-side scheduler job, queue row, claim, or staleness sweep exists for announcements, so this contract is the domain's WHOLE server surface (drift-checked by tools/check-openapi-drift.mjs). Writes require the time-announcements:admin capability (fail-closed via registerRoutesWithCapabilities, telemetry precedent); the list is kiosk-visible behind the standard auth boundary (TIME-ANNOUNCEMENTS-AC-07). Validation is strict-reject, never normalize (TIME-ANNOUNCEMENTS-INV-02/03); the active-overlap check runs inside the write transaction on POST and PATCH (TIME-ANNOUNCEMENTS-INV-04).

tags.name: weather
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Weather API**

Household location settings and forecast reads. Location may be unset. Provider unavailability is explicit; inactive plugin settings are omitted from effective settings.

tags.name: printing
tags.description:
**marplanner printing**

Durable printing jobs, printer capability registration, fenced claims, payloads, acknowledgement and failure reporting. Printed state requires a valid acknowledgement. The browser performs physical transport.

tags.name: network-devices
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Network Devices API**

Registered network devices, live controller inventory and block state. Every route requires an active credential with the network:admin (or full "*") capability; a normally provisioned household device qualifies. Provider failures use safe typed errors.

tags.name: backups
tags.description:
**Marplanner — Backups API**

Snapshot, shelf, download, upload, delete and quiescent restore operations. Requires backups:admin capability. Restore validates compatibility and takes a pre-restore snapshot before replacing the database.

tags.name: telemetry
tags.description:
**Marplanner Client Logging / Telemetry API**

Telemetry ingest + admin read. Ingest is best-effort at-most-once: a well-formed batch ALWAYS returns 200 (accepted/dropped counts), never 429 and never per-entry errors the client would react to. Redaction and bounding happen server-side before storage (Constitution II). Capabilities: telemetry:write (ingest) / telemetry:admin (read); full-access ('*') keys satisfy both.

tags.name: plugins
tags.description:
**Marplanner Plugin Lifecycle API**

Authenticated first-party plugin catalog and lifecycle mutations for. Canonical plugin state is active, inactive, or errored; operation is a separate transient projection. The API never accepts or returns the admin PIN or raw errors.
